checks.name: advanced-tests
checks: PASS directory estimates are phase-local, bounded and honest when work grows
PASS scan and verification report completed task counts without claiming success
PASS scan policies have explicit worker limits and low-impact yielding
PASS low-impact work pacing carries batches across directory boundaries
PASS low-impact pacing honors cancellation at a yield boundary
PASS unpaced strategies never introduce batch waits and concurrency records a peak
PASS actual allocation and file identities recognize hard links without double counting
PASS sparse files use allocated data rather than logical length
PASS compressed files report compressed allocation
PASS all scan modes keep identical logical and physical results
PASS typed phases and per-stage peaks distinguish verification from cache reuse
PASS allocated queries preserve deduplicated totals and expose unknown values
PASS unchanged journal reuses the tree without enumerating directories
PASS deep edits with preserved timestamps rescan only the changed directory
PASS directory moves, deletion and newly created subtrees match a full scan
PASS writes through a hard link outside the root invalidate all known aliases
PASS already-open writers remain dirty even without another journal record
PASS changes during a refresh are replayed from its start checkpoint
PASS journal gaps and unavailable journals safely fall back to a full scan
PASS cancelled incremental refresh leaves old logical and physical totals untouched
PASS journal record parser accepts IDs and rejects unsupported or malformed records
PASS real NTFS refresh agrees with a full scan and reports its actual path
PASS metadata verification catches deep edits with restored timestamps and hard-link alias writes
PASS metadata verification notices new directories and incomplete baselines force a full scan
PASS replaced directories with identical names and timestamps do not inherit cached file identities

checks.name: core
checks: PASS recursive totals, Unicode paths, empty folders, zero-byte files, sort order
PASS directory totals and parent references
PASS empty root
PASS missing root has explicit error
PASS pre-cancelled and mid-scan cancellation
PASS final progress matches completed scan
PASS deep directory traversal
PASS size formatting supports zero and sizes above 32-bit
PASS treemap empty/zero/degenerate inputs
PASS random treemaps preserve area, proportion, bounds, and do not overlap
PASS junctions are skipped to avoid cycles and duplicate counting
PASS hidden and system entries remain included
PASS root removed during scan fails rather than reporting an empty success
PASS cancellation on final progress is honored
PASS treemap extreme skew and non-finite bounds
PASS folder query sorting, case-insensitive search and zero-size rows
PASS type aggregation matches file totals and supports category search
PASS top-500 cutoff, exact type filter and aggregate area
PASS 100k-file query benchmark and deterministic top-file results
PASS refresh restores a surviving directory and rejects deleted/outside/file paths
PASS type drilldown supports extensionless/zero-byte files and combined search
PASS type count and file location sorting
PASS equal-size top-file boundary is stable across enumeration order
PASS type-map aggregation preserves totals and is explicitly marked
PASS queued directory replaced by a junction is rechecked before traversal
PASS pagination covers every row and clamps boundary requests
PASS parallel and serial scans match every entry and file timestamp
PASS cancelling active parallel workers stops without leaving a blocked queue
PASS queued directory disappearance records an issue and preserves siblings
PASS parallel workers count all skipped junctions exactly once
PASS worker exceptions propagate without deadlocking other readers
PASS scan concurrency bounds are explicit
PASS file nodes share an empty collection and scanner paths/extension storage
PASS preview appears before completion and held snapshots never mutate
PASS preview supports nested browsing, parent paths and rejects outside paths
PASS parallel scanning and preview queries safely run together
PASS preview cancellation and empty sessions have explicit behavior
PASS allocation-free path ordering matches full paths across prefixes and Unicode

checks.name: diagnostics-tests
checks: PASS strict record schema rejects unknown fields, enum values, duplicate keys, nulls and unbounded input
PASS persistent switch, corrupt preferences fail closed, explicit recovery and exception opt-out
PASS rotation and mixed-age retention remain bounded across wall-clock changes
PASS clear uses a generation barrier, preserves unrelated files and reports partial failure
PASS corrupt records and legacy report cannot contaminate the selected export
PASS atomic export matches immutable preview, cancellation/failure preserve the existing target
PASS notes restore, enforce revisions/limits and preserve unsaved or corrupt data
PASS note file byte cap refuses growth before overwriting
PASS queue overload is bounded, producer never waits on storage, off/clear isolate pending work
PASS multi-instance switch and clear invalidate old generations across services
PASS cross-process mutex contention has a finite wait
PASS storage errors remain nonfatal and bounded view reports truncation

checks.name: error-report-tests
checks.summary: All 3 error report regression groups passed.
checks: PASS error report whitelists fields and omits message, stack, data, inner exceptions and private paths
PASS error report avoids custom exception getters and retains one bounded report

checks.name: journal-tests
checks: PASS V1 request advertises supported formats and does not wait for close or future data
PASS native diagnostics keep categories and numeric errors without exception paths
PASS query failures and invalid headers cannot create a usable checkpoint
PASS V1 unprivileged read decodes 128-bit IDs and clips to the captured interval
PASS V0 compatibility fallback reuses the successful reader across chunks
PASS standard read fallback stays on the existing handle and reports failures
PASS journal gaps, rollback and volume replacement are rejected before reading
PASS stalled cursors and malformed or unknown records never become an empty change set
PASS post-read journal reset is detected and change lists stay bounded
PASS cancelled native reads do not return successful cached changes
PASS capture errors use full metadata verification and are not mislabeled journal incrementals
PASS missing checkpoint verifies once, then continuous no-change journal avoids enumeration
PASS read failure or lost continuity invalidates the plan and performs a full scan
PASS foreign-volume checkpoint cannot authorize reuse
PASS unusable cached identities fall back without misreporting a journal read failure
PASS root replacement cannot reuse old identities and force-full remains explicit
